claims.text: The api service (docker-compose.yml@stage-1:81-99) builds with context . and DonHang.Api/Dockerfile when the image donhang-api:stage-1 is missing or --build is given, sets ConnectionStrings__Default with Host=db, depends_on db service_healthy, joins donhang at .13.
The db healthcheck runs pg_isready -U donhang -d donhang every 3s with a 3s timeout and 30 retries; the container is starting until the first success and unhealthy after 30 consecutive failures.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: docker-compose.yml:75-79; Docker docs: HEALTHCHECK / Compose healthcheck

claims.text: Plain depends_on only orders container start; condition: service_healthy makes Compose wait until the dependency's healthcheck reports healthy.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Compose startup order / depends_on

claims.text: pg_isready succeeds when the server is accepting connections; after the db container starts, Postgres needs a few seconds before that happens.
claims.source_hint: PostgreSQL docs: pg_isready; postgres image docs (initialization)

claims.text: Program.cs applies migrations (context.Database.Migrate()) at startup before serving requests, so the API needs the database at startup.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: DonHang.Api/Program.cs (MigrationBaseline.ApplyIfNeeded, Database.Migrate before app.Run)

claims.text: Inside a container, localhost refers to the container itself; a service on the same Compose network is reached by its service name.

docker compose stop api db then docker compose up -d api starts donhang-db first, prints Waiting and Healthy for it, then starts donhang-api; a request right after may get 502 from Caddy and 200 a few seconds later; the api service has no healthcheck.
claims.source_hint: generator check on the running lab (first curl 502, after 5s 200)

claims.text: localhost:5432 works from the laptop because the db service publishes 5432; inside the API container, Host=localhost gives SocketException (111) Connection refused at startup; Docker's default healthcheck interval is 30s (the lab sets 3s).
claims.source_hint: docker-compose.yml db ports; reviewer r1 run; Docker docs: HEALTHCHECK defaults

claims.text: CMD-SHELL runs the healthcheck command through the container's shell; pg_isready is a PostgreSQL client tool that reports whether the server accepts connections.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Compose healthcheck test; PostgreSQL docs: pg_isready
